subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Turtle and the World
description: One-minute skill: The Turtle and the World.

hook.text: In Hindu myth, the earth rests on a turtle's back. In Iroquois myth, North America grew on a turtle's shell.

buildup.text: Turtles carry their homes. They're slow but endure forever. The shell became a symbol of the cosmos itself.

discovery.text: Vishnu's second avatar, Kurma, is a turtle who supports a mountain during the churning of the cosmic ocean.

twist.text: Terry Pratchett's Discworld sits on four elephants on a turtle. He turned world-turtle myth into bestselling fiction.

climax.text: The turtle says: the world needs a stable foundation. Something patient, ancient, and slow holds everything up.

punchline.text: Turtles all the way down. Maybe.

quiz.question: In Iroquois creation myth, what role does the turtle play?
options: North America grows on its shell
